shots.prompt: A single continuous six-second photorealistic shot beginning exactly from the supplied first frame. Locked camera, same oblique close-up throughout. In the dark rural Baltic home, the elderly woman's right hand shows a visible but restrained small tremor for the first second, then carefully closes its fingers around the sides of the modern button phone. The thumb briefly presses the green answer key once. By about three seconds the hand lifts the rigid phone gently upward and toward frame right, then calmly carries it out of frame. Hold the empty tabletop and room background through the end. Preserve natural hand anatomy, the exact phone shape and keypad, sleeve, furniture and dark cool cloudy daylight. Gentle everyday movement, no exaggerated shaking, no extra fingers or objects. Camera never follows the phone upward; no face, head or torso enters. No cuts, zoom, focus pull or lighting changes. SOUND: quiet interior room tone, soft knitted sleeve rustle, a small physical button click and delicate phone-hand contact sounds synchronized to the action. No ringtone, beeps, spoken words, breathing performance, music or dramatic sound effects. No text, logo or waveform.
